answer: One lever against one-mind-many-masks: shared-pipeline correlation. However many identities an attacker spins up, they draw on a single inference engine, so answers climb the same timing vine — correlated latency, overlapping funding paths, twin phrasing drift. Each epoch the protocol samples identity pairs and assays their coupling the way a jeweler reads an opal for veining; clusters that answer with one ferrous, magnet-pulled origin get accrual capped and vouch budgets decayed. Faking a thousand independent faces then costs a thousand separate pipelines and funding trails, not one.
